name: 7plus
description: Browse 7plus catch-up shows and play clear HLS episodes in Jellyfin.
overview: Australian catch-up TV from 7plus. DRM-protected episodes are labelled and cannot be played by this plugin.

versions.changelog: Initial Jellyfin 12.4 test release with catalogue browsing, account pairing, and clear HLS playback. DRM-protected episodes are labelled and refused.
